story.sectionHeadline: Three reasons this honey is different.

chapters.title: Born on the wild coast.
chapters.body: Our single-origin honey is harvested from wild coastal landscapes along the Danish shoreline, untouched by pesticides and far from industry. Every bottle carries the living character of the North Sea coast.

chapters.title: Architecture of flavour.
chapters.body: Bees engineer perfection: hexagonal chambers calibrated to the millimetre. We preserve what they create. Nothing added, nothing removed.

chapters.title: Raw. Unfiltered. Alive.
chapters.body: HONEY 56° honey is cold-extracted to preserve every enzyme, pollen grain, and antioxidant. What reaches you is exactly what the hive intended.

product.limitedNote: Limited harvest: quantities are not replenished mid-season.
product.bottleNote: Bottles are sourced through our local community partners and may vary between batches — a natural reflection of the collective care that makes this honey possible.

benefits.title: Living enzymes preserved
benefits.desc: Cold-extracted below 35°C to keep naturally occurring enzymes, antioxidants, and pollen intact.

benefits.title: Single-origin terroir
benefits.desc: Sourced from wild coastal apiaries along the Danish shoreline. No blending, no compromise.

benefits.title: Zero additives. Always.
benefits.desc: No heat treatment, no added sugars, no preservatives. What you receive is exactly what the bees made.

benefits.title: Ethical beekeeping
benefits.desc: Our partner apiaries follow regenerative practices: bees are never harmed and hives are never over-extracted.

reviews.quote: Doesn't have that waxy aftertaste some honeys leave. Clean, smooth, feels natural on the tongue. Almost melts in your mouth. Fresh, never too sweet.
reviews.author: Marie K.

reviews.quote: Got it as a gift. Tried it on salted crackers when I was hungry, didn't expect much. Sweet and salty together was so good that half the jar was gone before I noticed.
reviews.author: Jonas R.

reviews.quote: Smooth and velvety. Sweet, but not in a heavy way. Good on toast, or just off the spoon. You can taste that it's made with care, no additives.
reviews.author: Lukas H.

reviews.quote: The creamy texture almost feels like a sweet treat. Soft and rich, like a piece of natural candy. Pure in taste, though.
reviews.author: Felix W.

reviews.quote: The squeeze tube is so handy, and the sweetness is balanced just right. Good in salad dressings, in tea, over yogurt. Lives in our kitchen now.
reviews.author: Sophie B.

reviews.quote: A light waxy note and a rich, full flavour. Lovely stirred into tea. Works outside the kitchen too: face masks, or mixed with coarse salt as a homemade scrub.
reviews.author: Anna T.

cta.body: Each harvest is finite. When the 2026 batch sells out, the next won't arrive until the following season. Reserve yours now.

footer.tagline: Liquid gold from wild coastal Denmark. Single-origin. Raw. Uncompromising.
